x: The press made much of the participation of two guest runners; Joseph Njugana, a Kenyan brought to the race by John Bicourt, ran without a number and won with ease and Dave Taylor, a Blackheath athlete, came an unofficial 4th.
8 Surrey 5 kms, Wimbledon: 1, D.Taylor (Blackheath) 15:15; 4, R.Alsop 15:48; 6, P.Coughlan 16:02; 7, S.Clarke 16:07; 24, A.Cowmeadow 18:06; 55, R.Bale 21:42; 57, C.Cross 22:45 (1st M60); 62 finished.

But two miles into the race it was Boxhill's Paul Haywood who had taken the initiative, 30 metres up on Blackheath's Taylor who was in turn heading a bunch of seven runners that was being chased by Paul, 9th, and Lee 15th.
